Definition: Targets : Total passing attempts aimed at the receiver.
Receptions : Total successful catches.
Catch Rate : Percentage of targets resulting in a reception.
Receiving Yards : Total yardage accumulated.
Yards per Reception : Average yardage gained per catch.
Yards After Catch : Yardage gained by the receiver after securing the ball.
YAC per Reception : Average post-catch yardage.
Yards per Route Run : Total receiving yards divided by total routes run.
Average Depth of Target : Mean depth of targeted throws.
Longest : The yardage of the player's longest single reception.
Passer Rating when Targeted : The QB's passer rating on throws to this receiver.
Route Percentage : Frequency of snaps where the player ran a route.
Pass Block % : Percentage of pass snaps where the player was used as a blocker.
Contested Targets : Targets where the defender has a legitimate chance to play the ball.
Contested Catches : Total catches made in contested situations.
Contested Catch Rate : Efficiency in securing contested targets.
Missed Tackles Forced : Defensive tackles evaded after the catch.

Total snaps and percentage of snaps lined up as an outside receiver.
